::: {.premise}
Earth is dying. In the twenty-second century it launches its Genesis seedships
toward every star within reach, each carrying frozen embryos and a guardian
intelligence with the whole of human knowledge aboard.

Each ship raises a first generation, seeds a colony, and goes to sleep.
Thirteen thousand years later their children have forgotten Earth, found each
other again, built an empire and lost it. This is their history.
:::

## Two ways in

[The Chronicles](chronicles/index.qmd) are the fiction: people living inside
this history, who mostly do not know they are inside it.

[The Galactic Encyclopedia](encyclopedia/index.qmd) is the world itself: the
drives, the wormhole network, the habitability scale, the ships and the worlds,
and the long argument between what physics permits and what people attempt
anyway.

::: {.spoiler-note}
Some encyclopedia entries carry a closed Spoiler panel. Nothing opens on its
own. If you would rather meet those things inside a story first, leave them
closed.
:::
